operations.description: - This API is used to batch add or delete tags to or from a public NAT gateway. - TMS needs to use this API to manage tags of resources in batches. - A resource can have up to 20 tags.
- This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a private NAT gateway. - TMS uses this API to batch manage tags of a private NAT gateway. - A private NAT gateway can have up to 10 tags.

- This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a specified transit IP address. - TMS needs to use this API to batch manage tags of a specified transit IP address. - A transit IP address can have up to 10 tags.
- This API is used to batch add or delete tags to or from a transit subnet. - TMS uses this API to batch manage tags of a specified transit subnet. - A transit subnet can have up to 20 tags.
This API is used to create DNAT rules in batches.
This API is used to create a public NAT gateway.
This API is used to create a DNAT rule.
This API is used to create an SNAT rule.
- This API is used to add a tag to a public NAT gateway. A resource can have up to 20 tags.
This API is used to create a DNAT rule.
This API is used to create a private NAT gateway.
- A private NAT gateway can have up to 10 tags. - This API is idempotent. - If a tag to be created has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.
This API is used to create an SNAT rule.
This API is used to assign a transit IP address.
- A transit IP address can have up to 10 tags. - This API is idempotent. - If a tag to be created has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.
Creating a Transit Subnet.

- This API is used to add a tag to a specified transit subnet. - A transit subnet can have up to 20 tags. - This API is idempotent. - If a tag to be added has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be added and overwrite the existing one.
This API is used to delete a public NAT gateway.
This API is used to delete a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to delete a specified SNAT rule.
- This API is used to delete a tag from a public NAT gateway.
This API is used to delete a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to delete a private NAT gateway.

- This API is idempotent. - When a tag is deleted, the tag character set is not verified. Before calling this API, encode the API URL. If the key of the tag to be deleted does not exist, 404 is displayed. The tag key cannot be left blank or be an empty string.
This API is used to delete a specified SNAT rule.
This API is used to release a transit IP address.

- This API is idempotent. - When a tag is deleted, the tag character set is not verified. Before calling this API, encode the API URL. If the key of the tag to be deleted does not exist, 404 is displayed. The tag key cannot be left blank or be an empty string.
Deleting a Transit Subnet.

- This is an idempotent API to delete a tag from a transit subnet. - When a tag is deleted, the tag character set is not verified. Before calling this API, encode the API URI. The server must decode the API URI. If the key of the tag to be deleted does not exist, 404 will be displayed. The key cannot be left blank or be an empty string.

- This API is used to query public NAT gateways by tag. - Tag Management Service (TMS) uses this API to filter and list public NAT gateways. - By default, public NAT gateways and their tags are sorted by creation time in descending order.
This API is used to query DNAT rules.
This API is used to query SNAT rules.
This API is used to query the specifications of public NAT gateways that can be created.

- This API is used to query tags of all public NAT gateways owned by a tenant in a project. - TMS uses this API to list tags created by a tenant to ease tag creation and resource filtering on the console.
This API is used to query public NAT gateways.
This API is used to query DNAT rules.

- This API is used to query tags of all private NAT gateways owned by a tenant in a specified project. - TMS uses this API to list tags of all private NAT gateways owned by a tenant, and to provide tag association when users tag or query private NAT gateway.
This API is used to query private NAT gateways.
- This API is used to query private NAT gateways by tag. - TMS uses this API to query and list private NAT gateways by tag.
This API is used to query SNAT rules.
This API is used to query the list of NAT gateway specifications supported by a project.

- This API is used to query tags of all transit IP addresses owned by a tenant in a specified project. - TMS uses this API to list tags of all transit IP addresses owned by a tenant, and to provide tag association when users tag or query transit IP addresses.
This API is to query transit IP addresses.
- This API is used to query transit IP addresses by tag. - TMS uses this API to query and list transit IP addresses by tag.
Querying Transit Subnets.

- This API is used to query tags of all transit subnets of a tenant in a project. - TMS uses this API to list tags of all transit subnets, and provides tag association when users tag or filter transit subnets.
- This API is used to query transit subnets by tag. - TMS uses this API to filter and list transit subnets by tag.
This API is used to query details about a specified public NAT gateway.
This API is used to query details about a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to query details about a specified SNAT rule.
- This API is used to query tags of a public NAT gateway. - TMS uses this API to query all tags of a public NAT gateway.
This API is used to query details about a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to query details about a specified private NAT gateway.
- This API is used to query tags of a specified private NAT gateway. - TMS uses this API to query all tags of a specified private NAT gateway.
This API is used to query details about a specified SNAT rule.
This API is used to query details about a specified transit IP address.
- This API is used to query tags of a specified transit IP address. - TMS uses this API to query all tags of a specified transit IP address.
Querying the Details of a Transit Subnet.
- This API is used to query tags of a specified transit subnet. - TMS uses this API to query all tags of a specified subnet.
This API is used to update a public NAT gateway.
This API is used to update a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to update a specified SNAT rule.
This API is used to change the billing mode of a public NAT gateway from pay-per-use to yearly/monthly.
This API is used to update a specified DNAT rule.
This API is used to update a private NAT gateway.
This API is used to update a specified SNAT rule.
